_comments: #435: the two default-contact foreign keys on Sales Account read 'Default Primary Contact ID' and
'Default Billing Contact ID', the label CodeGen derives from the column name when no AI pass runs.
THESE ARE THE FK ROWS. Both have a RelatedEntityNameFieldMap (DefaultPrimaryContact /
DefaultBillingContact), so mj-form-field already labels the form field from those virtual rows,
which read without the suffix. The FK row's own DisplayName is what a grid column, a view and the
filter builder show, and what CodeGen falls back to when it titles a related section on the Sales
Contact form. AutoUpdateDisplayName goes to 0 so the label stays a choice.
